data.name: App.ProductName
data.comment: The product name. Marked invariant: the same word in every language, and it must never come back translated.

data.name: App.Title
data.comment: Application bar title. Keep the product name; translate what follows the dash.

data.name: Dashboard.WelcomeBack
data.comment: Greeting on the dashboard. {0} is the signed-in user's display name. Arabic puts the name after a comma too; keep the placeholder wherever the greeting needs it.

data.name: User.DisplayName
data.comment: The signed-in user's given name as this session's language writes it. A transliteration, not a translation.

data.name: Nav.Dashboard
data.comment: Navigation entry. A noun - the overview screen.

data.name: Nav.Customers
data.comment: Navigation entry. A noun, plural.

data.name: Nav.Contacts
data.comment: Navigation entry. People at customer companies, not the verb.

data.name: Nav.Settings
data.comment: Navigation entry. Application settings.

data.name: CustomerEditor.Saved
data.comment: Confirmation after a successful save. One whole sentence.

data.name: Customer.LastOrder
data.comment: One whole sentence. {0} is the customer name, {1} the date of the last order, already formatted for the reader. Both placeholders must appear.

data.name: Validation.Required
data.comment: Validation message, one whole sentence.

data.name: Validation.Email
data.comment: Validation message when the address does not parse. One whole sentence, imperative.

data.name: Contacts.Contact
data.comment: Grid column header. The person, singular.

data.name: Contacts.Company
data.comment: Grid column header. The organisation the contact works for.

data.name: Contacts.City
data.comment: Grid column header. The town, not the municipality.

data.name: Contact.Dana
data.comment: A person's display name in this language's script. Data identifies the row; this is only how the name is written for this reader.

data.name: Contact.Omar
data.comment: A person's display name in this language's script - see Contact.Dana.

data.name: Contact.Priya
data.comment: A person's display name in this language's script - see Contact.Dana.

data.name: City.Milan
data.comment: City name. Many languages have their own form (Mailand, Milano); use it.

data.name: City.Doha
data.comment: City name - see City.Milan.

data.name: City.Pune
data.comment: City name - see City.Milan.

data.name: Language.en-US
data.comment: Entry in the language picker. Invariant: a language list shows every language in its own language.

data.name: Language.de-DE
data.comment: Entry in the language picker. Invariant - see Language.en-US.

data.name: Language.fr-CA
data.comment: Entry in the language picker. Invariant - see Language.en-US.

data.name: Language.ar-SA
data.comment: Entry in the language picker. Invariant - see Language.en-US.

data.name: Language.qps-ploc
data.comment: Entry in the language picker. A test locale, not a language. Invariant.

data.name: Status.Direction
data.comment: Status strip. {0} is a culture name and is never translated; {1} is Direction.Ltr or Direction.Rtl.

data.name: Direction.Ltr
data.comment: Reading direction, lower case, used inside Status.Direction.

data.name: Direction.Rtl
data.comment: Reading direction, lower case, used inside Status.Direction.
